support.missionTitle: About the project and its goal
support.missionP1: My name is Artur Petrunko. The goal of this project is not to make money, but to build an honest AI analysis of public procurement for a country that deserves it. I am convinced that artificial intelligence is exactly what can ensure fair tenders and systematically reduce corruption.
support.missionP2: Today, at the procurement stage, there is no intelligent matching of goods against their real market prices. Once such a system is in place, it will clearly show procurement transparency and where the excess money goes. According to preliminary estimates, this is about billions of hryvnias that could be saved for the country every year.
support.stateP1: Right now, <link>ai-prozorro-intelligence.vercel.app/uk/dashboard</link> already runs 2 analyses. But due to limited computing resources, a weak AI model is currently used, and the analysis works like this: first the Risk Index (AI) is calculated using mathematical methods, and only then AI is engaged — only for the most critical cases. Because of the resource shortage, the system does not yet have a market-price compliance assessment — and that is the most important function for detecting overpayments.
support.whyIntro: For example, a state institution recently purchased 50 keyboards on ProZorro at 450 UAH each. The same model costs ~250 UAH at retail on Rozetka (without a bulk discount). The difference:
support.whyOverpay: Overpayment: <red>10,000 UAH</red> on a single keyboard purchase alone — and that is without a bulk discount, which would lower the price even further
support.whyP2: Multiply such cases by thousands of tenders per year — and it amounts to billions of hryvnias in overpayments. To detect such cases automatically, at the scale of the entire ProZorro system, a full local LLM with real-market price matching is needed — not just a mathematical risk index.
support.whyP3: In the future, I am ready to develop the project into a larger version, hand it over or fully adapt it for the civil service and higher authorities to improve their work. Now and going forward, the project will remain completely free for everyone. In the long run, oversight bodies and society will be able to obtain additional procurement analytics, check purchases against market prices, and systematically counter corruption.
support.whyP4: That is exactly why the fundraiser is open — it is the minimum needed to launch the local project so as not to depend on third-party AI services and monthly subscriptions. Analyzing sensitive government data requires a dedicated local LLM tuned to the specific work with tenders.

legal.title: Data Source and Legal Framework
legal.dataSourceP1: All data used on this platform (information about tenders, participants, procuring entities, amounts and procurement statuses) is obtained from the official Prozorro public procurement system via its open API and constitutes public information in the form of open data.
legal.dataSourceP2: According to the official position of SE "PROZORRO", the data of the Unified Electronic Procurement System is permitted for further free use and distribution. Any person may freely copy, publish, distribute and use this information, including for commercial purposes, in combination with other information or by including it in their own product, provided that a mandatory reference to the source of such information is given.
legal.lawsIntro: The use of this data is also based on:
legal.law1: The Law of Ukraine "On Access to Public Information";
legal.law2: The Law of Ukraine "On Public Procurement";
legal.law3: Resolution of the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine No. 835 "On Approval of the Regulation on Data Sets Subject to Publication in the Form of Open Data", which classifies public procurement data as mandatory open data sets.
legal.aiTitle: Disclaimer on AI Analysis and the Risk Index
legal.aiP1: The "Risk Index (AI)" is generated by an automated model based on publicly available Prozorro data (number of participants, buyer history, procurement characteristics, etc.) and reflects the statistical correspondence of a tender to typical procurement patterns.
legal.aiP2: This index is a preliminary analytical assessment and is not a conclusion about a violation of the law, the presence of corrupt actions, or bad faith of the procuring entity or procurement participant. The final assessment of a procurement's compliance with the law can only be provided by an authorized state body (in particular, the Antimonopoly Committee of Ukraine, the State Audit Service of Ukraine) based on the results of an official review.
legal.aiP3: The platform is not a mass media outlet and does not conduct journalistic investigations — it provides an open-data analytics tool for informational purposes.

common.aiDisclaimer: The "Risk Index (AI)" is a preliminary analytical assessment based on Prozorro open data. It is not a conclusion about a violation of the law and has no legal force.
